At some point in history, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] hid '''a bioweapon''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aaeton]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Imperials activated the weapon, causing the rapid spread of the [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon's]] toxic molds through the planet's settlements.<ref name="Tor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
